title: Concierge-seed the launch gym's roster and a live session (cold-start)
description:
PROBLEM: The funnel's ENDPOINT does not exist for a solo new user: the first match depends on a gym manager seeding a live session, and Gyms/Rankings are empty until seeding happens. The strongest, most consistent research finding (atomic-network / gym-by-gym saturation) is that a new athlete must open into a populated LOCAL roster, not a national leaderboard of 6. This is the actual launch-readiness blocker and outranks most client polish for real retention; it is under-weighted because it is ops/data, not code.

EVIDENCE: Recon: 'No real first value is reachable in-app by a new user's own action'; ordinary users cannot create sessions (gym-manager gated, gyms/[id].tsx:175,239); research: saturate ONE gym first, atomic networks (https://uxcam.com/blog/10-apps-with-great-user-onboarding/ ; Andrew Chen atomic network)

PROPOSED CHANGE: Process + data, NOT a schema change. Using the existing gym_managers / is_gym_manager seeding (service-role), onboard the launch gym's full roster and seed at least one live/upcoming session so a new athlete in that city opens into real local opponents and a joinable session. Manually seed the first ~50 athletes via concierge outreach. Add a verified-gym badge as the anti-ghost-town trust signal for the skeptical BJJ audience. This is the precondition that makes the aha reachable; the Home 'Find your first match' CTA and the Gyms tab are dead ends without it.

AFFECTED: jr_be/supabase/ (seed scripts, service-role), no app code change required for the seeding itself

Group: BiggerBet | Effort L | Impact High. From research/012-ftue-discovery-roadmap.md (rec #11).
acceptance_criteria: A test athlete created in the launch city sees a populated local gym roster, not an empty list ; At least one joinable live/upcoming session exists at the launch gym ; The launch gym shows a verified-gym indicator ; The Home 'Find your first match' CTA leads to a real session a user can actually join ; Seeding uses service-role + existing gym_managers infra, no schema migration

title: Instrument the activation funnel end-to-end (analytics layer)
description:
PROBLEM: There is NO product analytics in the repo (only Sentry error tracking). The field-cliff, the aha threshold, and every 'High impact' claim in this roadmap are currently UNMEASURABLE. Pre-launch is the only time to instrument TestFlight cohorts; you cannot retro-measure them. This is the single highest-leverage missing item across all four expert lenses.

EVIDENCE: lib/error-tracking/sentry.ts is the only telemetry; no analytics SDK in package.json; research: the only way to confirm the cliff and define aha is your own funnel analytics (https://www.lennysnewsletter.com/p/how-to-determine-your-activation ; https://amplitude.com/blog/aha-moment)

PROPOSED CHANGE: Add a lightweight cross-platform analytics module under @jits/shared (so web and mobile share event names) and emit the ladder: signup_started, signup_submitted (with method: email|google), wizard_step_viewed{tos,identity,training}, athlete_activated, push_primer_shown/accepted/declined, first_session_joined, first_match_result (the aha). Choose a privacy-respecting SDK; adding a native analytics SDK may need a new EAS build (verify, flag as build-gated). Wire the activation event off the existing status re-read in use-setup-submit.ts:112-121. Then run a retention-correlation analysis once data exists to confirm/replace the assumed aha.

AFFECTED: packages/shared/src/analytics/ (new), apps/mobile/lib/profile-setup/use-setup-submit.ts, apps/mobile/app/(auth)/signup.tsx, apps/web/app/(auth)/ (signup/eua)

Group: BiggerBet | Effort M | Impact High. From research/012-ftue-discovery-roadmap.md (rec #10).
acceptance_criteria: Every funnel event in the ladder fires with correct properties on both platforms (or mobile-first if web is descoped) ; athlete_activated fires exactly once per activation, off the verified status flip ; No PII beyond what privacy policy permits is sent ; A dashboard/query can compute activation rate = signups reaching athlete_activated within the window ; If a native SDK is required, the new-EAS-build dependency is documented

title: Give zero-state Home one Signal-Red primary CTA and branch the free-agent plate copy
description:
PROBLEM: A freshly-activated user lands on an all-empty Home whose single forward action is a low-emphasis mono 'Find a session ->' link inside a dashed box, leaving the brand's one-primary-CTA slot unused for the new-user goal. Worse, the no-session accent plate is rendered UNCONDITIONALLY, so a free agent (who has no gym) is told 'Your gym hasn't designated a live session yet', which is incoherent and signals the app does not know their state. Web already branches this on primary_gym_id; mobile did not.

EVIDENCE: home/index.tsx:176-181 (unconditional 'Your gym hasn't designated a live session' Plate, no primary_gym_id branch); recent-activity-section.tsx (low-emphasis 'Find a session' link); web apps/web/app/(app)/page.tsx:331-333 branches on primary_gym_id; CLAUDE.md one-primary-CTA-per-surface rule

PROPOSED CHANGE: Client-only UI. (1) When the user has 0 matches and no live session, render ONE full-width Signal-Red primary CtaButton near the top of Home: 'Find your first match' -> routes to /(app)/gyms. This is the surface's single primary CTA; demote the existing buried link to the populated state only. (2) Branch the plate copy on athlete.primary_gym_id exactly like web: gym-having user keeps 'Your gym hasn't scheduled a session yet'; free agent gets 'You're competing as a free agent. Browse partner gyms near you to find an open mat or live session.' Keep the ELO tile narrative as 'Your starting rating'; do NOT turn any numeric value red. Static only, no confetti. CRITICAL: this CTA points at the Gyms tab, so it MUST ship in the same release as the Gyms empty-state fix or it routes users to a dead end.

AFFECTED: apps/mobile/app/(app)/(tabs)/(home)/index.tsx, apps/mobile/components/home/recent-activity-section.tsx

Group: QuickWin | Effort S | Impact Medium. From research/012-ftue-discovery-roadmap.md (rec #3).
acceptance_criteria: Zero-state Home shows exactly one Signal-Red primary CTA routing to /(app)/gyms; no second red CTA competes ; The no-session plate copy differs for free agents (no 'your gym' language) vs gym-having users, matching web's branch ; The primary CTA disappears (replaced by the existing populated-state UI) once the athlete has >=1 match, with no flicker during the stats fetch ; No numeric value (ELO, W/L/D) is rendered in Signal Red

title: Reframe the zero-match profile: kill '0%' win rate and anchor the bare ELO 1000 as provisional
description:
PROBLEM: A new jiu-jiteiro sees a '0%' win rate (reads as 'loses every match', not 'new') and a context-free ELO 1000 (1000 of what? good? bad?). In BJJ culture you EARN standing by showing up; branding someone a 0% loser on day one is culturally backwards and de-motivates exactly the competitive user the app wants. The empty/dead-looking profile is the documented #1 first-run risk for a rating app.

EVIDENCE: profile-quick-stats.tsx:62,65 (renders '0%' for null/zero winRate); athlete/competitor-header.tsx:32 (also '0%' when total===0); research: empty profile is the #1 rating-app first-run risk, anchor the number as a starting line (https://uxcam.com/blog/10-apps-with-great-user-onboarding/ ; growth.design/psychology)

PROPOSED CHANGE: Client-only formatting of data already on screen (totalMatches, current_elo). (1) When totalMatches===0 render Win Rate as the word 'New' (NOT '0%', NOT an em-dash which is brand-banned); apply to BOTH profile-quick-stats.tsx AND competitor-header.tsx AND any Home StatOverview so '0' does not leak elsewhere. (2) On the Home EloTile add a small MetaTag 'PROVISIONAL, Unranked until your first ranked match' beneath the 1000. (3) Add one anchoring line near the ELO: '1000 is everyone's starting rating. Win ranked matches to climb.' Keep the ELO number in JetBrains Mono default foreground, NEVER red. Do NOT imply belts map to ELO (belts are earned on the mat).

AFFECTED: apps/mobile/components/profile/profile-quick-stats.tsx, apps/mobile/components/athlete/competitor-header.tsx, apps/mobile/components/ui/elo-system/elo-tile.tsx, apps/mobile/app/(app)/(tabs)/(home)/index.tsx

Group: QuickWin | Effort S | Impact High. From research/012-ftue-discovery-roadmap.md (rec #2).
acceptance_criteria: A zero-match athlete sees 'New' (or equivalent) for win rate, never '0%', on every surface (own profile, competitor header, home stats) ; Home EloTile shows a PROVISIONAL tag and one anchoring sentence when totalMatches===0 ; The ELO numeric value remains JetBrains Mono tabular-nums and is never rendered in Signal Red ; Copy makes no claim that ELO maps to or assigns a belt rank ; Once the athlete has >=1 match, the real win-rate percentage and no PROVISIONAL tag render

title: Gate the cold push prompt behind a branded in-context primer
description:
PROBLEM: The iOS push permission dialog fires automatically the instant the athlete row activates and Home mounts, with zero context. iOS gives exactly ONE native prompt per permission, so a cold ask at the worst possible moment (brand-new user, zero matches, no reason to say yes) buys a PERMANENT per-device deny, after which challenge/match alerts silently never arrive. This is the single highest-confidence fix in the panel: the call site is trivially gateable and expo-notifications is already in the binary.

EVIDENCE: register-push.ts:44-48 (ensurePermission calls Notifications.requestPermissionsAsync cold); push-registration-bootstrap.tsx:23-38 (effect keyed on athleteId fires registration on activation); research: iOS push is opt-in and one-shot (https://www.nngroup.com/articles/permission-requests/ ; https://www.appcues.com/blog/mobile-permission-priming)

PROPOSED CHANGE: Stop auto-firing requestPermissionsAsync on activation. Split registration into (a) push-TOKEN registration that runs when permission is ALREADY granted (getPermissionsAsync === granted, no prompt), and (b) the native prompt, which fires only from the affirmative CTA of a branded primer Plate (dark, sharp corners, no motion). Persist a 'push_primer_shown' flag in AsyncStorage. CRITICAL per critique: do NOT tie the primer to a value moment the cold-start product cannot deliver (first challenge/first session may never happen for TestFlight users). Trigger the primer on a reachable moment: entering the Gyms tab for the first time, or second app open. Copy: 'Get notified the moment someone challenges you or your match is confirmed.' Do NOT add iOS provisional authorization here, that is a build-gated item (see separate BiggerBet).

AFFECTED: apps/mobile/lib/notifications/register-push.ts, apps/mobile/lib/notifications/push-registration-bootstrap.tsx, apps/mobile/app/(app)/(tabs)/gyms/index.tsx, apps/mobile/components/ui/elo-system/ (new primer Plate)

Group: QuickWin | Effort S | Impact High. From research/012-ftue-discovery-roadmap.md (rec #1).
acceptance_criteria: No OS push dialog appears on first Home mount after activation (verified on a fresh device/simulator) ; Push token still registers automatically when permission was already granted, with no prompt ; The branded primer appears once at a reachable trigger (Gyms tab entry or 2nd app open) and only fires the native prompt on its affirmative CTA ; AsyncStorage primer-shown flag prevents the primer reappearing ; Declining the primer leaves the app fully usable and does not re-nag

title: TestFlight launch crash: monorepo root package.json poisons RN/Hermes ABI (RN 0.82 vs 0.81.4)
description: Root package.json (commit 2538fd9) replaced the workspace scripts+husky with an erroneous, duplicated react-native* dependency block: react-native 0.82.0, react-native-worklets ^0.6.0, react-native-reanimated ^4.1.3, react-native-svg, react-native-web. These hoist to root node_modules and conflict with apps/mobile's SDK 54 pins (RN 0.81.4 / worklets 0.5.1 / reanimated ~4.1.1). npm ls reports react-native 0.81.4 'deduped invalid: 0.82.0'. The mixed RN/Hermes JSI ABI corrupts the Hermes heap at launch. All 4 TestFlight crash logs (builds 2 & 3) are Hermes heap corruption (HadesGC oldGenCollectionWorker tripwire abort, DictPropertyMap::findOrAdd, HiddenClass::findProperty, shared_ptr release) with garbage fault addresses and NO Last Exception Backtrace -- i.e. memory corruption, not an uncaught JS/env exception. Side effects of the same bad edit: root lost scripts (typecheck/test/build:web/db:types) and husky devDep, so the pre-commit gate silently stopped running. apps/mobile/package.json and root package.json both have duplicate keys (botched merge). Fix: restore root package.json to known-good initial version (8d57e85: scripts+husky, no RN deps); dedupe apps/mobile keys; reinstall; verify single RN 0.81.4 tree + expo install --check + expo export.

title: Web in-session challenge accept fails: accepter passed as timekeeper
description: apps/web/hooks/use-session-lobby-realtime.ts:172 calls createInSessionMatch with timekeeperId: currentAthleteId (the accepter, who is also a competitor in the match). Same RPC validation as jits-9l4 rejects this with 'Timekeeper cannot be a competitor in the match'. Result: web user clicks Accept on an incoming challenge and silently sees nothing happen (the broadcast challenge_accepted is never sent because the mutation fails first). The original c0b985e fix was meant to enable the timekeeper-live recorder step on web; that step gates on match.timekeeper_id === athlete.id, so dropping the timekeeper id reverts to fighter-live (no recorder). Two viable fixes: (1) drop the timekeeperId assignment and run the recorder on both fighter devices like mobile does, (2) change the BE RPC to allow caller-as-timekeeper. Option 1 is symmetric with the mobile fix and unblocks the demo without a migration. Affects 013 video flow.
close_reason: Verified fixed on development branch (2026-05-26 audit). jits-zyq + jits-9l4: createInSessionMatch in apps/web/hooks/use-session-lobby-realtime.ts:172 and apps/mobile/app/(app)/session/[id]/lobby.tsx:80-82 both omit timekeeperId now (caller is no longer passed as timekeeper). jits-y91: all 4 router.* navigation calls in apps/web/hooks/use-session-lobby-realtime.ts use router.push (lines 86, 110, 122, 176), not router.replace. jits-e0w: apps/mobile/components/match-flow/steps/confirm-step.tsx wires useMatchCompletion (postgres_changes on matches row) + a myConfirmed && opponentConfirmed effect; auto-advance works for DB-side confirms. jits-65p: both apps/web/app/(app)/match/[id]/results/submission-fields.tsx:70 and apps/mobile/components/match-flow/steps/submission-fields.tsx:52 label finish_time as '(optional)' correctly.

title: In-session challenge fails: caller-as-timekeeper rejected by RPC
description: Mobile lobby (apps/mobile/app/(app)/session/[id]/lobby.tsx:75) and web realtime hook (apps/web/hooks/use-session-lobby-realtime.ts:172) pass the calling athlete as timekeeperId to createInSessionMatch. The BE RPC create_session_match (jr_be/supabase/migrations/20260501000000_session_matches_ranked.sql:88-92) explicitly rejects timekeeper_id matching either competitor with 'Timekeeper cannot be a competitor in the match' (HINT invalid_timekeeper). Result: every in-session challenge currently fails with a toast and no match is created. Introduced in c0b985e while trying to enable the 013 video flow on web. Mobile recording is per-device (uploaderAthleteId=me.athlete_id in live-step.tsx) and never needed timekeeper to be set, so removing the assignment on mobile is the right fix. Web's fighter-live vs timekeeper-live routing needs a different approach (e.g. recorder always-on for both fighters, or BE RPC change to allow caller-as-timekeeper). Affects the 013 demo.

title: Mobile video upload retry generates new filename; double-orphan path
description: apps/mobile/lib/video/use-video-recorder.ts:88-101 retries entire uploadRecording on failure, which calls buildMatchVideoStoragePath again with fresh Date.now() -> NEW filename. First failed upload may leave partial object at path A; retry writes path B; upsertMatchVideo UPDATE points at path B. Two orphan paths possible per session. Fix: pass storage path explicitly to retry, or skip path regeneration.

title: Video upload: orphan storage file when DB insert fails
description: apps/web/hooks/use-video-recorder.ts:91-106 and apps/mobile/lib/video/upload-recording.ts:121-136. Storage PUT succeeds, then upsertMatchVideo throws -> file sits in bucket forever. No supabase.storage.remove() compensation. Web hook surfaces error toast (line 104) but no cleanup. BE has no documented GC. Fix: try { insert } catch { remove storage object }.

title: Mobile video upload uses POST instead of PUT; retry fails with 400
description: apps/mobile/lib/video/upload-recording.ts:99 uses httpMethod='POST' for Supabase Storage. /object/<bucket>/<path> expects POST for create, PUT for upsert. x-upsert: false + POST works on first try, but retry against same path returns 400 'resource already exists'. The retry-once logic in use-video-recorder.ts:88-101 then double-fails. Web SDK .upload() handles this internally.

title: Video upload: videoId lost on unmount mid-upload (orphan file)
description: apps/web/hooks/use-video-recorder.ts:151-155 and apps/mobile/lib/video/use-video-recorder.ts:162-169. Cleanup useEffect only stops media tracks; does NOT cancel in-flight upload promise. State setters fire on unmounted component (React warning + videoId lost). If upsertMatchVideo throws after storage PUT succeeded, file is orphaned in match-videos bucket with no DB row.

title: Rules of Hooks violation in MatchFlowWizard
description: apps/mobile/components/match-flow/match-flow-wizard.tsx:69 calls React.useCallback AFTER conditional early returns at lines 59-64. On the render where match first arrives, hook count changes and React throws 'Rendered more hooks than during the previous render.' Fix: move advanceToResult above the early returns. Effort: 1 line.
close_reason: Fixed: moved advanceToResult useCallback above the early returns in match-flow-wizard.tsx so hook order is stable. Verified via npm run typecheck (all 3 workspaces clean).

title: Make email confirmation recoverable in-app and build the missing reset-password screen
description:
PROBLEM: If Supabase requires email confirmation, signup hands the user a 'Check your email' wall with only 'Back to Sign In', no resend, no polling, forcing a leave-app/confirm/return/manual-relogin round trip mid-onboarding. Separately, the password-reset loop is BROKEN: the deep link routes the reset token to /login which never consumes it, so a forgotten password is unrecoverable in-app, a hard retention defect independent of FTUE.

EVIDENCE: signup.tsx confirm screen has no resend (verified); auth-context returns needsEmailConfirmation when no session; deep-links/handler.ts:42-44 routes reset-password token to /login with comment 'the dedicated reset-password screen does not exist yet'; auth-context has resetPassword but no resend/updateUser-with-token path

PROPOSED CHANGE: TWO parts, sequenced by a config check FIRST. (A) Check the Supabase project's email-confirmation setting. If it is OFF (cheapest, dominates building resend UI), the entire confirm dead-end disappears at zero engineering cost, but note it is a backend/ops toggle with a spam/throwaway-email tradeoff that pollutes the cold-start roster, so weigh it. If confirmation stays ON, add a 'Resend confirmation email' action (supabase.auth.resend) and prefer the deep-link return path the handler already has over a battery-draining getSession poll. (B) Regardless of the confirmation setting, BUILD the missing reset-password screen: consume the token the handler already forwards and call updateUser with the new password. Part B is the higher-value half and should ship even if confirmation is off.

AFFECTED: apps/mobile/app/(auth)/signup.tsx, apps/mobile/lib/auth/auth-context.tsx, apps/mobile/lib/deep-links/handler.ts, apps/mobile/app/(auth)/reset-password.tsx (new)

Group: Medium | Effort M | Impact Medium. From research/012-ftue-discovery-roadmap.md (rec #12).
acceptance_criteria: The Supabase email-confirmation setting is checked and the decision (on/off) is documented ; If confirmation is on, the confirm screen offers a working Resend action ; A reset-password screen exists, consumes the deep-link token, and successfully calls updateUser to set a new password ; A user who forgot their password can fully recover in-app without leaving for a browser ; No getSession polling loop runs on a backgrounded screen

title: Remove stubbed/ghost surfaces so the app does not feel broken to a TestFlight reviewer
description:
PROBLEM: A prominent disabled Signal-Red 'Challenge' button on every athlete profile only toasts 'Challenges coming soon', a visible no-op that both violates the one-meaningful-primary-CTA rule and is exactly what the competitor persona says makes them abandon. Settings exposes CHAT and CHALLENGES toggles for features not shipped on mobile, and a realtime-test debug screen ships in the production settings stack.

EVIDENCE: athlete/[id].tsx:124-134 (disabled Challenge button toasts 'Challenges coming soon'); app/(app)/settings/realtime-test.tsx present in shipping settings dir (verified via ls); settings/notifications.tsx exposes CHAT/CHALLENGES toggles

PROPOSED CHANGE: Pure client hides/removals, zero backend, no build. (1) HIDE the head-to-head Challenge button until the flow exists (do NOT repoint it to the in-session-lobby path, that requires an active-session context the profile screen lacks and is M-effort with breakage risk). (2) Hide the CHAT and CHALLENGES settings toggles behind a not-built condition, after verifying they are purely cosmetic and do not orphan backend notification-preference rows. (3) Remove realtime-test.tsx from the production settings stack entirely (move behind a __DEV__ guard rather than dev-flag, so a wrong default cannot ship it).

AFFECTED: apps/mobile/app/(app)/athlete/[id].tsx, apps/mobile/app/(app)/settings/notifications.tsx, apps/mobile/app/(app)/settings/realtime-test.tsx, apps/mobile/app/(app)/settings/_layout.tsx

Group: QuickWin | Effort S | Impact Medium. From research/012-ftue-discovery-roadmap.md (rec #7).
acceptance_criteria: No disabled 'coming soon' Challenge button is visible on athlete profiles ; CHAT and CHALLENGES toggles are not visible in settings, and hiding them does not break any persisted notification preference the backend expects ; realtime-test is unreachable in a production (non-__DEV__) build ; No Signal-Red CTA in the app is a no-op

title: Make city optional/auto-derived in the activation wizard (the ONLY safe field to slim)
description:
PROBLEM: The wizard hard-blocks submit on a non-empty city even though the backend activation trigger does NOT require it, and the city dropdown is built only from cities that already have gyms with a hardcoded Toronto/Vancouver fallback. So an unserved user is forced to pick a city that isn't theirs and literally cannot complete activation honestly, the field-count cliff made worse by an impossible field.

EVIDENCE: validation.ts:62-69 (isTrainingComplete requires city.trim()); use-setup-data.ts:39-48 (city list gym-derived with Toronto/Vancouver fallback); CLAUDE.md trigger contract needs display_name + current_weight + gym/free_agent + gender + DOB, NOT city; research: every required pre-aha field costs signups (https://foundrycro.com/blog/form-conversion-rate-benchmarks-2026/)

PROPOSED CHANGE: Client-only one-line-plus change that does NOT touch the trigger and never writes guarded columns. Remove city from isTrainingComplete so it is optional for activation, AND auto-derive city from the selected gym's city (the gym join already carries city per CLAUDE.md FK notes) so most users never see a city picker at all. Keep weight + gym-or-free-agent as the activating step (load-bearing for weight-aware ELO). DO NOT defer or remove gender/DOB, the critique verified these are TRIGGER-REQUIRED; removing them would silently break activation (the classic guard/trigger no-op loop) since use-setup-submit.ts:112-121 only shows a generic 'activation failed' with no field-level diagnosis. If free-text city is wanted later, it needs normalization (Toronto/toronto/TO fragments the gym-city dropdown), defer that.

AFFECTED: apps/mobile/lib/profile-setup/validation.ts, apps/mobile/lib/profile-setup/use-setup-data.ts, apps/mobile/components/profile-setup/training-step.tsx, apps/mobile/lib/profile-setup/use-setup-submit.ts

Group: QuickWin | Effort S | Impact Medium. From research/012-ftue-discovery-roadmap.md (rec #6).
acceptance_criteria: A user can complete activation without manually selecting a city ; When a gym is selected, the athlete's city is auto-populated from the gym's city ; gender and date_of_birth remain required in the wizard gate (NOT deferred) ; Activation still flips pending->active for both gym-affiliated and free-agent users (verified end-to-end) ; No write occurs to any guarded column (id, auth_user_id, current_elo, highest_elo, status, created_at, role)
notes: NUANCE (CHANGELOG 2026-06-02, build 8): city was JUST made a REQUIRED native picker that AUTO-FILLS from the chosen gym. So 'auto-derive from gym' is already shipped; the remaining friction is only the FREE-AGENT case (no gym to derive from). Do NOT blindly revert the required-city decision; scope this to: make city optional ONLY when free_agent, or auto-fill always. ALSO: resolve the gender/DOB activation-requirement conflict (CLAUDE.md says required; bd memory athlete-column-guard-trigger + recon say the trigger does not enforce them) against handle_athlete_activation BEFORE touching anything but city.

title: Add Google SSO to the signup screen
description:
PROBLEM: 'Continue with Google' is the single fastest activation path, it skips three credential fields AND the entire email-confirmation detour, but it lives only on /login. A first-timer who taps 'Register' lands on a credential form and never sees the one-tap option, so the fastest path is invisible to exactly the users who need it.

EVIDENCE: login.tsx:60-64,130-132 (onGooglePress + 'Continue with Google'); auth-context.tsx exposes signInWithGoogle; signup.tsx has zero SSO (grep found no Google/Apple/SSO references); research: SSO lifts signups 20-40%, ~60% of mobile users prefer it (best-practice findings)

PROPOSED CHANGE: Render the existing 'Continue with Google' button as the primary fast path at the TOP of the signup screen, with the email/password form as a secondary 'or sign up with email' section below. signInWithGoogle already exists in auth-context, so this is a pure UI wire-up reusing login's onGooglePress pattern, no new auth code, no build. Adjacent micro-win: add a show/hide toggle to the password fields. HONEST CAVEAT per critique: SSO skips credential entry but the user STILL hits the activation wizard, so do not oversell it as a fast path to a rated profile, only to an account. SEQUENCING RISK: shipping Google without Apple on an iOS launch can INCREASE App Store rejection exposure (guideline 4.8), so do not ship this to the PUBLIC build before the Apple Sign In BiggerBet lands; for the internal TestFlight it is fine.

AFFECTED: apps/mobile/app/(auth)/signup.tsx

Group: QuickWin | Effort S | Impact High. From research/012-ftue-discovery-roadmap.md (rec #5).
acceptance_criteria: The signup screen shows 'Continue with Google' as the topmost option with email/password below as a secondary section ; Tapping it invokes the same signInWithGoogle flow as login and lands the user in the activation wizard ; Password fields have a show/hide toggle ; No new native dependency is added and no new EAS build is required ; Account-linking risk is documented as an open question (same email via Google vs email/password)

title: Turn the 'No Gyms Found' / unserved-city dead-end into a real path (client-only half)
description:
PROBLEM: Every Home CTA funnels to the Gyms tab, whose only empty state is a bare dashed 'No Gyms Found' label with zero call-to-action, and the city filter only lists cities that already have a gym, so a geographically-unserved user cannot even select their own city. This is the single worst FTUE dead-end: an instant uninstall for a competitor in a non-seed city.

title: TestFlight launch crash: native TurboModule throws NSException at launch, corrupting Hermes (newArch)
description:
SYMPTOM: ELO RATED iOS TestFlight (com.elorated.mobile) crashes ~0.5s after launch. 4 crash logs (builds 2 & 3) in DoKWRbP0qRetPvPAPA-zLs.xccrashpoint share one signature.

EVIDENCE (crash logs):
- All 4 crash inside Hermes with DIFFERENT garbage fault addrs each run (0x30, 0x08000024, 0x646e6582) and NO Last Exception Backtrace -> heap corruption, not a clean uncaught JS/env throw.
- Decisive frame in 3 of 4: facebook::react::TurboModuleConvertUtils::convertNSExceptionToJSError (RCTTurboModule.mm). Build-2 SIGABRT log: objc_exception_rethrow -> __cxa_rethrow -> std::terminate.
- Throwing call runs on a libdispatch worker thread (ObjCTurboModule::performVoidMethodInvocation) WHILE the JS thread runs the event loop -> off-thread Hermes access -> VM corruption.
- newArchEnabled:true (app.json:12, ios/Podfile.properties.json), Hermes. New-Arch off-thread TurboModule-exception marshalling is the amplifier.

ROOT CAUSE (two layers): (1) a native Obj-C TurboModule method THROWS an NSException during launch [trigger]; (2) RN New-Arch converts it into Hermes off-thread [turns recoverable throw into hard crash]. Must identify WHICH module throws.

TOP SUSPECTS (run unconditionally at launch, native, background queue, depend on signed-build entitlements that differ dev vs TestFlight):
1. expo-secure-store getItemAsync via Supabase auth getSession -- lib/supabase/secure-storage.ts:27 <- lib/auth/auth-context.tsx:57. Keychain entitlement / keychain-access-group mismatch from unfinished eas init / provisioning. NOT try/catch-wrapped at the JS boundary.
2. expo-notifications setNotificationHandler + addNotificationResponseReceivedListener -- lib/notifications/handlers.ts:26,35 <- push-registration-bootstrap.tsx:20 (ungated). aps-environment / remote-notification entitlement (app.json UIBackgroundModes:remote-notification).
Both consistent with the open pre-launch blocker: eas init placeholders + unfinished Apple provisioning (Team ID, push key, entitlements).

RULED OUT: RN/Hermes version skew -- single react-native@0.81.5 tree (npm ls deduped), reanimated 4.1.7 + worklets 0.5.1 correct. Sentry not in the crash stack (initSentry early-returns without DSN; lib/error-tracking/sentry.ts). Supabase module-load env throw (jits-00q) would be a clean JS Error, not this off-thread native corruption.

NEXT STEP (decisive -- get the actual NSException reason):
(a) Release build on-device: npx expo run:ios --configuration Release, read '*** Terminating app due to uncaught exception' in Xcode/Console; OR
(b) Console.app / idevicesyslog filtered to process ELORATED during TestFlight launch; OR
(c) provision EXPO_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN + @sentry/react-native expo config plugin so next build reports it.
Then: fix the named module's entitlement/config AND wrap launch-path native calls (SecureStore getItem, notification handler setup) in try/catch so a native throw degrades instead of crashing.

NOTE: This session did NOT change app code (a version-realign attempt was reverted; tree clean, 179 tests green). Crash fix still pending the exception-reason capture above. Related: jits-00q (env-var fix, likely necessary but not sufficient).

title: Add a merged 'How rating works' explainer in plain BJJ language (anchored to ELO inline copy)
description:
PROBLEM: The core value (a meaningful rating) is expressed in chess/programmer jargon: 'ELO 1000', 'ranked vs casual', 'Pressure Score', 'weight_division_gap +50 phantom ELO', with no BJJ-native anchor. The competitor persona understands belt/stripe/weight class/open mat instantly but not these terms. If the rating does not map to what they feel in the gym, the number is noise and they will not trust or chase it, and trust in the rating IS the product.

EVIDENCE: CLAUDE.md business rules (weight-aware +50/division, draws cost both via Pressure Score, casual does not change rating); competitor persona jargon list; research: goal-matched, value-mapped explanation reduces the 'this number is noise' bounce (https://www.airbridge.io/en/blog/social-proof-for-apps)

PROPOSED CHANGE: Client-only content. MERGE with the inline ELO anchor (the 0%/ELO-anchor quick win): keep the one-line anchor inline on the EloTile, and put the fuller explanation behind a single dismissible info affordance off the tile, ONE static screen, not a multi-screen tutorial. Copy in gym language: 'Everyone starts at 1000. Win ranked matches to climb. Beat someone heavier or higher-rated and you gain more. Casual rolls don't change your rating; ranked matches do. Draws cost both athletes a little.' CONTENT-CORRECTNESS RISK: pull the exact rules from the BE FRONTEND_INTEGRATION_GUIDE / research/005, do not paraphrase from memory, wrong rules destroy trust. Brand: amber for draws, green only for gains, no red on numbers. Do NOT auto-assign a belt from ELO.

AFFECTED: apps/mobile/components/ui/elo-system/elo-tile.tsx, apps/mobile/components/ (new how-rating-works modal)

Group: Medium | Effort S | Impact Low. From research/012-ftue-discovery-roadmap.md (rec #14).
acceptance_criteria: An info affordance on the Home ELO tile opens a single dismissible 'How rating works' screen ; The copy accurately states: 1000 start, ranked-vs-casual, heavier/higher-rated wins earn more, draws cost both (verified against BE docs, not memory) ; No belt rank is implied to map to ELO ; Draws shown amber, gains green, no numeric value in red ; It is one screen, not a multi-step tour

title: Unify the three progress counters into one continuous, entry-path-aware label
description:
PROBLEM: The user crosses three disconnected counters: login shows none, signup says 'Step 1 of 2 / Account', then the wizard restarts at 'Step 1 of 3'. The real journey is ~4 steps; each counter implies near-completion then resets, undermining the goal-gradient pull progress meters are meant to create.

EVIDENCE: signup.tsx:96 ('Step 1 of 2 / Account'); wizard-progress.tsx:21 ('Step 1 of 3'); login has no counter; research: progress bars lift multi-step conversion (https://foundrycro.com/blog/form-conversion-rate-benchmarks-2026/)

PROPOSED CHANGE: Adopt one continuous static counter across signup->activation: signup '1 of 4', TOS '2 of 4', Identity '3 of 4', Training '4 of 4, almost there'. Keep it a static mono label / segmented bar (no animated fill) per the motion rule. CRITICAL per critique: the SSO path skips the password-entry portion of signup, so make the counter conditional on entry path (an SSO user effectively starts at the wizard), or it will lie to SSO users. The two surfaces are separate route groups ((auth)/signup vs profile-setup), so the offset must be passed/recomputed across the navigation boundary.

AFFECTED: apps/mobile/app/(auth)/signup.tsx, apps/mobile/components/profile-setup/wizard-progress.tsx, apps/mobile/components/profile-setup/setup-wizard.tsx

Group: QuickWin | Effort S | Impact Low. From research/012-ftue-discovery-roadmap.md (rec #8).
acceptance_criteria: A continuous 'Step N of 4' label appears across signup and the wizard with no reset to 'Step 1' mid-journey ; The counter is correct for the email path (starts at 1) and the SSO path (does not claim a skipped step) ; The indicator is static (no animation) per the minimal-motion rule

title: Improve Gyms tab load performance + loading UX
description:
The Gyms tab feels slow/unresponsive on first open (observed live on iOS sim). Root causes found in code review:

1. getGymsWithSessions() (packages/shared/src/api/queries.ts:452) runs THREE sequential, independent network round-trips (gyms -> athletes -> sessions). They have no data dependency and should be Promise.all'd. Biggest win: ~3x -> ~1x latency.
2. The Gyms screen hook useGymsList() (apps/mobile/app/(app)/(tabs)/gyms/index.tsx:48) fires a 4th query for gym coords (id, latitude, longitude) that duplicates the gyms table read already done in getGymsWithSessions step 1. Fold latitude/longitude into that first select to drop a round-trip.
3. No caching / no stale-while-revalidate. Every first mount pays full latency and shows a bare centered ActivityIndicator. Consider a lightweight shared cache so re-navigation is instant, and show cached data immediately while refreshing in background.

Loading UX improvements to make broadly (not just Gyms):
- Replace bare centered spinners with skeleton placeholders (perceived performance).
- Stale-while-revalidate pattern for list screens so navigating back to a tab is instant.
- Audit other tabs (Rankings/leaderboard, Home, Profile) for the same sequential-query and no-cache patterns.
notes: Surfaced during live iOS-sim debug session 2026-05-29. Measure before/after with timing instrumentation. Web app may share getGymsWithSessions so verify both consumers.
close_reason: Done on feat/loading-states (merged to development @ f1d535d): shared Skeleton primitive + SWR cache hook + skeletons & caching on all 4 tabs + parallelized getActiveSession/profile queries. Remaining micro-opt (fold gym coords into the main fetch) deferred: the coords query already runs in parallel so it is not a latency bottleneck.
